subject: [NEON] Move veor below if block
perf_evidence: Commit message says moving the NEON xor improves instruction interleaving on AArch64.
change_summary: Moves the NEON input/secret xor below the accumulator-width branch in XXH3_accumulate_512.

units.name: raw XXH3_accumulate_512, 64/128-bit accumulation widths, AArch64
units.evidence: Both accumulation-width targets with symbolic accumulator, input and secret bytes pass Alive2 in both directions on AArch64.

units.name: raw XXH3_accumulate_512, 64/128-bit widths, ARMv7 NEON
units.precondition: NEON widening multiplies replaced on both sides by equivalent unsigned lane arithmetic
units.evidence: Both ARMv7 targets pass bidirectional Alive2 after a documented symmetric vmull/vmlal semantic model; the initial shorter run timed out.

notes: The changed one-stripe computation is proved on both NEON architectures under the explicit widening-multiply model. No whole-hash public API proof over arbitrary lengths is claimed.
